description: Out-of-range confidence (>1) fails AuditFindingSchema's Zod shape check. In the live pipeline this exact case would actually be caught one step earlier, by AuditResponseSchema at the whole-tool-call level (triggering a retry, not a per-item drop) -- this fixture exercises validateAuditFindingItem's own Zod-shape-failure branch directly and defensively, since it is an exported function other callers could hand unvalidated data to.

rawFinding.issue: Confidence out of the valid [0,1] range.
rawFinding.action_required: N/A -- this finding should be rejected before it reaches a human.
